$comment: Jurisdiction constants for us-ga-hemp. These numbers belong here, never in core/ (core denylist grep test in tests/run.mjs). Every figure is cited to research-synthesis-ga-hemp-rule-read-and-d8449.md, which read them from GA Comp. R. & Regs. 40-32-5-.06 (primary) via the GA Secretary of State rules portal. Consumed by schema/v0.1/profiles/us-ga-hemp/rules/index.mjs — this file is the single source of the numbers; the rule module reads it rather than re-declaring the figures.

edible.citation: 40-32-5-.06 (research-synthesis-ga-hemp-rule-read-and-d8449 P1). The 150mg figure that appeared in an earlier secondary-source draft was wrong; 300mg is the primary-rule number — do not carry 150 anywhere.
edible.notes: Cap table is per product_form, not a scalar. per_piece_mg compares against a cannabinoid reading with basis=per_serving (core has no 'per_piece' basis; a gummy piece is treated as one serving — see rules/README.md#basis-mapping). per_package_mg compares against basis=per_package.

beverage.notes: A beverage container is sold as a single serving, so per_serving_mg compares against a cannabinoid reading with basis=per_serving (same mapping as edible's per_piece_mg — see rules/README.md#basis-mapping). container_max_volume checks net_contents directly, matched by unit (fl_oz).

tincture.citation: 40-32-5-.06 (research-synthesis-ga-hemp-rule-read-and-d8449 P3). Primary rule overrides a contradicting secondary source (C1: 1mg/serving, 10oz package) — primary wins.
tincture.notes: per_ml_mg is checked as concentration: a package's basis=per_package THC mg divided by net_contents (unit mL). container_max_ml checks net_contents directly.

topical.notes: No per-serving cap for topicals — container cap only.

total_thc_formula.citation: SB 494; GA Dept. of Agriculture (research-synthesis-ga-hemp-rule-read-and-d8449 P5)
total_thc_formula.applies_when: the 0.3% formula is evaluated against percent_dry_weight readings when present. If a hemp_derived package's linked LabResult has no percent_dry_weight for both THCA and THC, fail closed (formula cannot be evaluated; needs DW verification). This is a fail-closed encoding of the profile's own formula, not an assertion that 40-32-5-.06 / SB 494 requires DW on every COA.

coa_gate.max_age_basis: GA rule states '12 months'; encoded here as 365 days (see rules/README.md#twelve-months-as-365-days for the rounding note).
coa_gate.citation: GA Dept. of Agriculture guidance (research-synthesis-ga-hemp-rule-read-and-d8449 P6); decision-coa-publication-gate
